scope: Static dynamic widget item construction, indexed context/part resolution and the Ask wrapper join. For the selected authenticated Ask template and built-in factories, successful allocation/resource parsing produces a named Button as ListBoxItem Content. This is a reconstructed static path, not executed materialization or rendering.
evidenceTier: MIXED, see tierVocabulary and each observation

tierVocabulary.STATIC: Observed native instructions/data or authenticated Lua 5.1 operand/constant flow at cited locators.
tierVocabulary.INFERRED: Conditional composition or API-flow interpretation from the named observations.
tierVocabulary.unknown: Not resolved by this bounded investigation.

producingMethod.native: Focused ghidra-cli static disasm/data queries in an existing analyzed target. Decompilation supplied leads only. Selected instructions, literals, vtable/COL/RTTI data and call flow were independently compared with the authenticated PE. This is not a database-wide analyzed-program/FileBytes identity claim.
producingMethod.script: Tracked tools/decode_lpb.py wrapper recipe and unchanged AST-selected ChunkReader, walk, instruction and OPCODES definitions in xivl-client-scripts:tools/build_quest_contracts.py, with standard-library dependencies. Wrapped/decoded identities, full consumption, selected PCs/chunk offsets, operands and referenced constants were authenticated. No script body is retained.
producingMethod.template: xivl-tools:tools/blowfish.py basename-key SQEX recipe, strict UTF-8, xml.etree.ElementTree parsing and exact re-encryption. The selected template direct-child order/count, childless Setter attributes and Button name were corroborated. No Button descendants or full XML hierarchy were inspected.

method.locatorConventions: Native addresses are absolute VAs. Lua PCs are one-based within the named prototype. Chunk offsets are zero-based in the full decoded chunk, with inclusive endpoints naming instruction starts. Require full decoded-chunk consumption.

native: Bounded PE instruction inspection, including the LLVM objdump route in docs/native-input-ui-boundaries.md
alternativeReproduction.script: Decode the two named inputs and compare the listed prototypes, binding/argument flow and constants with the producing reader definitions.
alternativeReproduction.template: Decode/re-encrypt the exact named AskWidget.tpl with the basename key, parse strictly and inspect only the selected direct declarations.

method.boundary: Producing methods and alternative reproduction procedures are distinct. No native call, widget load, Lua method, renderer or live session is reported as executed. Raw exports and private investigation artifacts are not tracked dependencies.

observations.claim: _addItem four-string native path reaches a dynamic resource-based construction route, rather than deriving the row type from the ListBox name alone.
details: The existing published contract owns the four Utf8String declaration and optional-leading-context routing.
At 0x0053AA4F the construction call receives item name, resolved context index, and template key. Its return is an index. At 0x0053AA5E item name and returned index enter 0x00537C60.
0x00538B70 allocates 0x48 bytes and constructs XamlControlContainer with 0x0096E4D0. It uses the indexed context root at X+0x2C.
0x00538C62-0x00538CB7 supplies literal ControlTemplate to XamlStaticResource and reaches 0x0094A270. That calls resource search 0x00948EF0 and parsing 0x0096A4C0.
0x009480E0 reads x:Key and TargetType, parses {x:Type, and returns the single type token through its output. Instruction operands and selected literals corroborate these names.

0x00538D2F-0x00538E08 composes a new element from the extracted target type and requested item Name using selected literals at 0x00FA0844/4C/54. The composed markup body is not retained in this report.
observations.limits: WIC-07 establishes the Ask template-key argument. WIC-08..WIC-13 bind the selected built-in factories and parsed controls, conditional on allocation/resource success and no pre-existing registry override.

observations.claim: The dynamic item route preserves a first parsed object, creates a separately named target-type root, and supplies the first object through IAddChild. For a ListBoxItem root that slot reaches Content, not the Template setter.
details: The first object is read from container+0x30 and saved, and container+0x30 is zeroed before the second parse.
0x0052EA80 searches the named root and returns its pointer+0x194. 0x00538FA4 calls that interface slot+4 with the saved first object.
ListBoxItem constructor installs secondary vtable 0x0107AE74 at complete object+0x194. Its +4 cell at 0x0107AE78 contains 0x00935160.
0x00935160 checks interface+0x1C0, adjusts ECX by -0x194, and calls 0x00934F40 with the supplied object, 0 and 1.
0x00934F40 supplies descriptor 0x01358F94 to 0x009367B0. Initializer 0x00F221E0 names that descriptor Content from string 0x0106B16C.
observations.limits: WIC-08..WIC-13 identify Button Content in ListBoxItem for the selected successful built-in route. The IAddChild step is not a Template-property assignment and does not prove execution.

observations.claim: Named item contexts map to separate XamlControlContainer records and control lookup within that record.
details: The constructed container is stored under the next integer index through the map at engine+0xD4. The next-index counter at engine+0x94 increments.
0x00537C60 searches engine+0xEC by item name and inserts its supplied integer index only when that name is absent. It ends ret 8, despite incomplete decompiler parameter recovery.
0x005353E0 resolves a context name in engine+0xEC to node+0x60 or -1.
0x005354D0 uses the nonempty leading context name to resolve an index, then constructs SetPropertyProcessor carrying engine, index, part name and property name.
0x00535690 resolves index through engine+0xD4 to the stored container pointer at node+0x10.

0x00537950 uses an index/name cache at engine+0x1DC. On a cache miss, 0x0053E480 searches container+4 and returns node+0x60. If it misses, container+0x30 supplies the fallback root for 0x0053C310 -> 0x00910980.
0x00538F8B-0x00538F98 also stores the named second root at container+0x34.
observations.limits: WIC-12 establishes TemplateButton_Answer publication in the selected fresh item scope. General resource/allocation success, removal/reopen and cache invalidation are not established.

observations.claim: Property writes use that indexed part pointer as the general property-engine receiver.
details: SetPropertyProcessor string slot forwards stored part name, property name, value string and index to 0x00537DE0.
0x00537DE0 calls 0x00537950 with part name and index and returns on a null result.
When its existing visibility gate permits the update, 0x00537F61 sets ECX to the resolved part pointer and 0x00537F63 calls 0x00912850.
observations.limits: General property application is established. Text-provider evaluation, layout and visible rendering were not investigated.

observations.claim: _addList is a separate Index/Action property route and must not be substituted for _addItem resource construction.
details: The callback at 0x006EBE00 calls 0x006EB070.
That routine picks a string and integer and writes properties Index and Action through 0x0075BB80.
observations.limits: The Action pickup value and downstream list-action callback semantics remain untraced.

observations.claim: Authenticated Ask LPB calls inherited addListBoxItem with ListBox_Answers, Item_Answers and 24, while its explicit ControlTemplate_ListBoxItem constant is supplied to command-template condition setup.
details: root/proto0 PC47-51 calls inherited addListBoxItem with receiver, ListBox_Answers, Item_Answers and 24. The three arguments are constants22,23,24, and the method is constant21.
root/proto0 PC41-46 separately calls _setUICommandTemplateCondition with ControlTemplate_ListBoxItem, TemplateButton_Answer, UILuaCommands.Operate and 5.
root/proto2 PC58-67 builds the context from Item_Answers and the loop index and supplies TemplateButton_Answer and Content to the property call.
observations.limits: These are original operands, not executed calls. The inherited wrapper mapping is established separately by WIC-07.

observations.claim: Ask row creation explicitly reaches _addItem with nil context, ListBox_Answers, ControlTemplate_ListBoxItem and each name Item_Answers1..Item_Answers24.
details: root PC499-504 binds proto166 as WidgetBaseClass.addItem and proto167 as WidgetBaseClass.addListBoxItem.
root/proto167 PC1-14 iterates from 1 through argument3 with step1. It appends tostring of the loop index to argument2 and calls addItem with receiver, argument1 and the resulting name.

root/proto166 PC1-6 forwards nil as the first native argument, argument1 as the second, ControlTemplate_ListBoxItem as the third and argument2 as the fourth. Its call supplies the receiver and four arguments and retains no return.
Combined with WIC-06, these static frames supply 24 one-based names Item_Answers1 through Item_Answers24 and the explicit template key.
observations.limits: Static argument flow is supported. WIC-08..WIC-13 provide the selected built-in successful-path construction. No executed form/resource load or live UI state is inferred.

observations.claim: The built-in ListBoxItem markup factory directly constructs the concrete ListBoxItem type.
details: The lazy registrar supplies literal ListBoxItem at 0x0106D3D8 to extension 0x01359EE0, whose constructor 0x00952550 installs vtable 0x0106DF74 and registers that name through 0x0094AA00.

Factory lookup 0x009492A0 searches the registry map at[0x01359C70]+4 and returns node+0x60. TemplateMarkupObject 0x0094AD90 uses the current element tag as the lookup key at 0x0094B5B3-0x0094B5CA and invokes extension slot+4.
Cell 0x0106DF78 holds callback 0x009525E0. That callback allocates 0x36C bytes and calls constructor 0x0099E140 at 0x0095264B.

Constructor 0x0099E140 installs primary vtable 0x0107AFB4 and secondary+0x194 vtable 0x0107AE74. Primary COL 0x0118001C points to TypeDescriptor 0x0126EBF4, whose RTTI name is .?AVListBoxItem@Controls@Sqwt@@.
observations.limits: Registration passes replacement flag 0. Existing registration is retained if present. This identifies the built-in route, not every possible runtime registry override.

observations.claim: Selected ControlTemplate parsing visits resource contents through non-control parser adapters before dispatching child control tags.
details: XamlStaticResource vtable 0x00F9D2B4 slot+8 is 0x0094A190. It recognizes ResourceDictionary and constructs XamlResourceDictionary 0x00545F20.
XamlResourceDictionary vtable 0x00FA2680 slot+8 is 0x0094A550. Its ControlTemplate branch calls XamlFrameworkTemplate constructor 0x0094E8E0 and traverses that selected DOM node with 0x00947040.

XamlFrameworkTemplate vtable 0x0106D9CC slot+0x0C is 0x00948FF0, which captures x:Key into parser+0x74 and handles TargetType. Slot+0x18 is 0x00947300, which checks requested key/type conditions before child traversal.
Child element callback 0x0094BDF0 handles .Triggers separately. Other child tags reach 0x0094AD90 at 0x0094BE97 and its control-factory lookup.
These parser constructors preserve the same container pointer at frame+4 and set their current control at frame+0x10 to 0. They do not instantiate a ControlTemplate control into C+0x30.
observations.limits: Selected-resource/key success is a condition of this static route. No successful resource load was executed.

observations.claim: The exact selected Ask template has only a childless scalar Setter followed by the named Button.
details: Exactly one ControlTemplate has x:Key ControlTemplate_ListBoxItem. It has exactly 2 direct child elements, ordinal1 Setter, ordinal2 Button.
The selected direct Setter has 0 child elements, raw Property IsTabStop and Value False.
The direct Button has raw Name TemplateButton_Answer and the SQWT Button tag.
No Button descendants or full XML hierarchy were inspected or retained.

observations.claim: The selected Button factory directly constructs a Button and publishes it as the first concrete control root in the fresh item container.
details: The Button literal at 0x0106D2DC is registered by 0x00950030 with extension vtable 0x0106DE14. Cell 0x0106DE18 contains callback 0x009500C0.
The callback allocates 0x3B4 bytes and calls constructor 0x00974410 at 0x0095012B. Its primary vtable 0x01073CAC has COL 0x0117D44C and TypeDescriptor 0x0126D244 with RTTI .?AVButton@Controls@Sqwt@@.

The direct Setter branch constructs SetterMarkupObject 0x0094F0E0, whose current control+0x10 is 0. It does not call the control constructor/publisher, and WIC-10 excludes a nested Setter.Value parse in this input.

Button callback passes the new Button P to MarkupObject constructor 0x00946830 with the inherited parser/container. That constructor copies parent frame+4 to its own+4 and, if C+0x30 is null and P nonnull, writes P there at 0x009468AA.

Combined with the fresh-container construction and selected-resource parsing recorded in WIC-01 and WIC-09, the first saved object at 0x00538ECE is the concrete Button P for this selected declaration.
observations.limits: Both allocation and parsing success are required. The built-in registration override qualification from WIC-08 also applies to Button.

observations.claim: TemplateButton_Answer is registered in that same item container before the new ListBoxItem root is parsed.
details: 0x00947040 finds the Name attribute with literal 0x0106D244, then applies it through 0x00912D50 at 0x00947104 before registering the control.
0x00912D50 uses Name descriptor 0x01356BC8 and storage at control+8. Initializer 0x00F20620 names that descriptor from Name literal 0x01068310.
When the resulting Name is nonempty and control+0x298 is 0,0x00947120 calls 0x0096E580 with ECX=C, Name and P.
0x0096E580 searches C+4 for the name, suffixing duplicates if required.0x0094D580 returns the node+0x60 value slot.0x0096E753 stores P there and 0x0096E75A stores C at P+0x298.

The fresh selected scope has the single direct named Button before the separately named ListBoxItem is parsed. The second parse preserves the same C, so the indexed resolver 0x00537950 can retrieve P from that scope by TemplateButton_Answer.
observations.limits: This is name-scope publication and static lookup, not a lifetime lease, rendered state or proof that every property setter is accepted at runtime.

observations.claim: For the selected default construction, the saved first root is Button P and the second generated root is ListBoxItem R, so the observed IAddChild+4 call supplies P as R.Content.
details: WIC-02 saves C+0x30, clears that field, and parses the generated named target-type root in the same container.
WIC-08 binds that generated ListBoxItem root R to 0x0099E140. WIC-11 binds the saved first object P to Button 0x00974410.
The selected row IAddChild slot+4 is 0x00935160, which reaches Content setter 0x00934F40 after subtracting 0x194 from its interface receiver.
The TemplateButton_Answer map entry remains associated with P and is independent of the new root name Item_AnswersN.
observations.limits: This closes the static selected-resource composition route. It does not establish visual parity, successful rendering, events, text evaluation or result delivery.

inferences.claim: Ask supplies the explicit template key and row names. With the selected resource and built-in factories, successful allocation/parsing creates a named Button in a fresh per-item container, then a separately named ListBoxItem whose Content is that Button. Indexed property writes select the item context and then the named Button.
inferences.boundary: Static selected successful-path reconstruction, not an execution trace. Built-in registrations retain any existing entry when replacement flag is 0. Allocation, resource selection and property-engine gates remain conditions.

Nil admission by the declared Utf8String marshaller, the widget registry class and complete bodies of 0x00535C80, 0x00539010 and 0x0053A970.
Dynamic removal/reopen/cache invalidation and any lifetime guarantee beyond the raw name-scope association P+0x298=C.
Transitive form/style/resource closure, Button descendants, text evaluation, events, selection/results, layout, geometry and rendered output.

boundaries: The selected authenticated Ask declaration and built-in successful path bind the first Button root, ListBoxItem factory and named-part publication. They do not establish every runtime override or successful allocation/resource load.
Built-in registration passes replacement flag 0 and retains an existing name entry. No global registry override census was performed.
P+0x298=C is a raw name-scope association, not a lifetime lease or stale-reference safety guarantee.
The saved Button enters ListBoxItem.Content through IAddChild+4. This is not an unconditional Template-property assignment.
The Nil callback branch is observed and the Ask helper supplies nil, but admission of Nil by the declared Utf8String marshaller remains untraced.
The widget registry class, complete bodies of 0x00535C80, 0x00539010 and 0x0053A970, and dynamic removal/reopen/cache invalidation remain unqualified.
_addList uses separate Index/Action writes. The Action pickup value and downstream list-action callback semantics remain untraced.
No arbitrary script, transitive form/style/resource closure, Button descendants or full XML hierarchy was inspected for the selected template finding.
The 24 wrapper-created row names are neither a visible-answer count nor a server selection/result numbering contract.
Text evaluation, events, input/result delivery, geometry, layout, pixels, live-session behavior and runtime or server parity are outside this record.
